title: Semiconductor Manufacturing
painPoint: Semiconductor fabrication demands ultra-precise magnetic fields for magnetron sputtering cathodes, ion implantation beam lines, and wafer-handling end effectors. Flux drift or field non-uniformity directly degrades thin-film thickness distribution, dopant placement, and yield. Vacuum chambers down to 1E-6 Pa reject standard NdFeB coatings that outgas hydrocarbons, while process temperatures above 150 degrees Celsius push N42 and N52 grades toward irreversible demagnetization. Equipment engineers need magnets with high intrinsic coercivity, low-outgassing finishes, and tight batch-to-batch Br consistency to qualify tools and hold repeatable process windows.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU supplies semiconductor-grade NdFeB magnets in 42SH, 38UH, 35EH, and 28AH grades engineered for vacuum and thermal extremes, with maximum operating temperatures from 150 to 220 degrees Celsius. Our Ni-Cu-Ni, TiN, and Parylene coatings are outgassing-tested for UHV compatibility, minimizing chamber contamination. Each batch ships with full BH-curve data and tight Br/Hcj tolerances for repeatable field performance, and custom arc-segment or Halbach-array geometries can be machined to your cathode or beam-line spec. Contact YOUJIU today for samples, qualification data, and volume pricing on your next fab tool build.
